entries.phase_name: Seal Evidence and Delivery Readiness Cleanup
entries.description: No blocking performance issue found in the reviewed Phase 6 code path; full-release checks are intentionally broader and slower than quick checks.
entries.suggestion: Keep full-release as explicit opt-in and monitor real runtime once porter readiness receipts are produced.

entries.description: The slower release checks are only added for full-release scope, and runPorterCommandCheck wraps command execution in a context timeout before collecting output. This keeps quick porter checks distinct from expensive release-tool verification.
entries.suggestion: Keep expensive GoReleaser, race, TypeScript, and npm checks behind --full-release unless release policy changes.

entries.description: Full-release Porter checks are intentionally behind the explicit --full-release scope, while quick checks remain smaller for routine readiness checks.
entries.suggestion: Keep full-release opt-in and use it only for seal/publish readiness so the slower race, GoReleaser, TS, and npm checks do not burden normal Porter checks.
